data.text:
The Philippines Will Not Yield

From the distant horizon where BRP Sierra Madre continues to hold its post, to the streets where Filipinos rally with flags and banners, one point is clear: the West Philippine Sea is ours to defend - with vigilance, unity, and truth. The scenes of harassment at sea, the steady patrols of the Philippine Coast Guard, and the daily struggle of our fishermen show what’s at stake, while the law is already on our side - UNCLOS and the 2016 arbitral ruling that found no legal basis for the so-called “nine-dash line.” Let’s turn awareness into action: share verified facts, reject disinformation, and stand with our frontliners and coastal communities. 

#DefendWPS #WestPhilippineSea #BRPSierraMadre  #SupportOurFishermen #UNCLOS #2016ArbitralAward #RuleOfLaw #FilipinosDoNotYield #AtinAngWPS
